method.MAE: Gross price excursion from actual16:00entry to minimum observed minute low before next09:30, also including exit09:30OPEN; never its low/close. Express positive adverse magnitude / priorATR. Incomplete holding paths give observed lower bounds; report all100 and complete-path subset separately.
method.chronology: Assert chronological entry>=previous exit per model and combination. All positions flat before next daily16:00boundary. Daily scores realized by that boundary:overnight result assigned next actual cash session even if a stop occurred in prior civil evening; B to its exit session. Use every cash session incl flat/early-close days from first eligible date to last, not trade-only or only1151clean-entry dates. No zero days during2022--2024 gap.
method.common: 1024 entry-session dates with PREOPEN SMA20 available (629old,395recent) inside fixed1151priorATR pool. These are candidate dates, not1024 guaranteed executable nights. Same next-actual-cash-session, same-contract, endpoint and usable-bar requirements as original A. No missing-price filling or crossing2021--2024.
method.comparators: ALL on common dates; BULL on these same dates with completed current RTHclose>current terminal SMA20 (known at16:00, exactly the base condition of original A). A_MATCHED is original A intersect common executable nights; also retain original A100 separately if masks differ. Report membership difference rather than forcing100 into1024. BULL is not yesterday preopen bull: it is entry-time close>SMA20, matching original A.
method.metrics: PF in R on net individual executions (also rawpoint/%PF for benchmark); report daily aggregated PF separately in JSON. Sharpe=sqrt252*mean full-cash-day netR/SD(ddof1), no account-risk-free/return-on-capital interpretation. MaxDD chronological observed minuteopens/closes plus known fills, fees atentry, in R and rawpoints. Quarterly netR and netpoints by daily16:00accounting session; report positive R quarters/quarters with trades.
method.missing_stop: Same100 observed-path simulations reported conditionally; missing scheduled minutes before simulated exit mean actual first-stop outcome cannot be certified. Also paired original/stop results on fully observed original holding paths, not a fitted exclusion. Missing minutes after an already identified stop cannot change that fill. No unknown bars are assumed safe.
method.portfolio: Primary A(original no stop)+B(original P/+1ATR), each full1/ATR unit per sequential position, no halfweight or fitted allocation. Raw points shown separately for1NQ/trade, not implied back-conversion of normalized sizing. Additional fixed A_STOP and A_STOP+B are labeled sensitivity, not chosen in hindsight.
method.preservation: Preserve all previous files and price_volume outputs. Exactly original A100 and B149, recomputed from source with unchanged selectors. No other models, parameter fitting, reversed shorts, best-of choice, live approval, Git push or deployment.
method.reproduce: Two source reconstructions, original A/B numeric and membership parity, normalization/fee identities, nonoverlap assertions, protected-file checks and byte-identical outputs.
method.scaling: ATR14 known before entry-session09:30, never next-day ATR. netR=(exit-entry-1.225)/entry_session_priorATR; netpct=100*(exit-entry-1.225)/entry_price. Percentage sums descriptive arithmetic sums, not compounded capital returns. Costs applied once per execution, including stopped trades.
method.stop: ONE fixed catastrophe-stop from16:00entry through next actual cash09:30open:entry-0.50priorATR rounded TOWARDentry to0.25tick. A stop touch fills level; gap through stop fills worse actual minuteopen, may lose>0.50R. Earliest observed trigger only, no target, no restart; same total1.225pt friction. Maintenance/weekends have no invented print. Endpointbar only open can trigger. No extra stop-slippage grid.
method.validation: Two periods and quarterly sequence are fixed-rule chronological stability, NOT new out-of-sample or honest walk-forward validation:both periods and survivor selection already consumed. No new significance tests or independent promotion.
